mapper.select: SELECT * FROM oa_invoice WHERE invoice_id = #{id} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND deleted = 0 FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE oa_invoice SET deleted = 1, version = version + 1, update_by = #{record.updateBy}, update_time = #{record.updateTime} WHERE invoice_id = #{record.invoiceId} AND tenant_id = #{record.tenantId} AND version = #{record.version} AND deleted = 0
